If you use assistive technology (such as a screen reader) and need a version of this document in a more accessible format, please email defra.helpline@defra.gov.uk. Please tell us what format you need. It will help us if you say what assistive technology you use.
Details
The public register sets out details of reprocessors and exporters registered and accredited by:
the Environment Agency (EA)
Natural Resources Wales (NRW)
the Scottish Environment Protection Agency (SEPA)
the Northern Ireland Environment Agency (NIEA)
The register is kept under review.
We update and publish the register on Thursday each week where there have been updates that week. We also update the register whenever an operator has their registration or accreditation suspended or cancelled.
The dates displayed for reports show the original submission date. Any subsequent resubmissions are not reflected.
